lines.text: I have a question for you. Do you remember when you built this? Probably not.
Why on earth would I remember what I built?
He built it by talking to AI. A hundred and twenty chats.
lines.caption: He built it by talking to AI. 120 chats.

lines.text: I read the agent logs, and remember how each project was built.
lines.hl: remember how each project was built

lines.text: Tell me about Hack Nation. What do you remember?
I mean, I know some keywords, but that's it.
So I remind him, until it sticks.
lines.say: [pause] So I remind him, until it sticks.

lines.text: And every week, his work becomes a podcast.
“Ja sluta fråga publicera.” Stop asking. Just publish.
Every agent he uses gets the same memory, and stops where he would.
lines.say: [pause] Every agent he uses gets the same memory, and stops where he would.

lines.text: All those memories will be lost in time.
Not anymore. Mason. Learning by doing, without the forgetting.
